I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random. I confirmed the correction: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats.

I also told him I don't keep notes from one conversation to the next, so the correction isn't saved anywhere on my side. Anyone reading #central-team will still see this morning's number, so I suggested he post the correction there himself. As he asked, I didn't change anything else.
